answer: Farming becomes a kernel bet on surviving 62 epochs of grading, and every pigment settlement recomputes the marble schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 62 epochs rather than arriving at once.
